caseName: Menasha Wooden Ware Co. v. Minneapolis, St. Paul & Sault Ste. Marie Railway
caseNameFull: Menasha Wooden Ware Company, in Error v. Minneapolis, St. Paul & Sault Ste. Marie Railway
summary: In error to the Circuit Court of Winnebago County, State, of Wisconsin.
attorneys: Mr. A. E. Thompson and Mr. J. C. Thompson for plaintiff in error, submitted., Mr. William A. Hayes and Mr. Alfred H. Bright for defendant in error.

opinions.text:

Judgment affirmed with -.costs upon the authority of Armour Packing Co. v. United States, 209 U. S. 56, 80 et seq.; Louis. & Nash. R. R. Co. v. Mottley, 219 U. S. 467; Portland Railway &c. Co. v.
